sections.chapter_title: Resource isolation slave unit for address space protection (full version) (RISAF)
sections.text_helper: Section 7.5.5 "RISAF illegal address register (RISAF_IADDR)" in chapter 7 (Resource isolation slave unit for address space protection (full version) (RISAF)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 267.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x024
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Secure, privileged, trusted domain CID = 1, read access only.
Bits 31:0 IADD[31:0]: Illegal address
When IAEF = 1 in RISAF_IASR, IADD[31:0] captures the address of the erroneous access.
Additional information can be found in RISAF_IAESR. Captured address information is the
byte offset from the base of the protected address space.
